name: Example simplified set
description: An illustration only, not a real scheme. Shows how a coarse operational set of a handful of categories can stay reconcilable with the full taxonomy during a staged transition. Every local value rolls up from source codes, so counts aggregate without loss.

mappings.note: Covers the 'your money is at risk' modi plus the fake institution modus.
These three replaced a single modus in v7.0. A local value at this level is stable across that split, which is one reason to map at a coarser level during a transition.

not_covered.note: This example deliberately does not map the first party fraud classification (D020 to D023). The taxonomy states those are for internal reporting and not for fraud intelligence sharing, so a derivation intended for cross-institution exchange should leave them out rather than map them.
